---
title: Browse
---

<div class="browse-controls">
  <input id="browse-search" type="search" placeholder="Search recipes…" aria-label="Search recipes" />
  <select id="browse-category" aria-label="Filter by category">
    <option value="">All categories</option>
  </select>
  <span id="browse-count" class="browse-count"></span>
</div>

<table id="browse-table" class="browse-table">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th data-sort="title">Title</th>
      <th data-sort="category">Category</th>
      <th data-sort="time">Total time</th>
      <th data-sort="portions">Portions</th>
      <th>Source</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody></tbody>
</table>
